CryptPad Onboarding

What is CryptPad?

slides.title: Welcome to CryptPad!
slides.html:
• CryptPad is a secure, end-to-end encrypted collaboration suite.
  • Your team can create and collaboratively edit documents and share files securely.
  • This Deploy App server has your team's own, decentralized CryptPad service.

slides.title: Why is CryptPad Secure?
slides.html:
• CryptPad ensures security such that not even the server administrator can read your files.
  • You decide who to share with.
  • Other users on this Deploy App server also need an invitation from you to read your files.

slides.title: Sign In with Deploy App
slides.html:
• CryptPad is integrated with Deploy App's certificate-based authentication.
  • Click Log in to CryptPad and you will be automatically authenticated using your Deploy App credentials.
  • No separate account or password is needed.

slides.title: Your CryptPad Dashboard
slides.html:
• After signing in, you'll see your CryptPad dashboard.
  • From here you can create new documents, access recent files, manage your CryptDrive, and collaborate with team members.

slides.title: Create Your First Document
slides.html:
• Click the + button on your dashboard to create a new document.
  • Choose from rich text, code, spreadsheets, kanban boards, presentations, whiteboards, forms, and more.
  • All documents are encrypted automatically.

slides.title: Share with Your Team
slides.html:
• To share a document, click the share button in the toolbar.
  • Share with specific team members or create a link.
  • Multiple users can edit simultaneously and see each other's changes in real time.
